jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . Join us in creating a better world of work. Culture Amp is looking for an exceptional Senior Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Customer Success team. You’ll work alongside Account Managers, Renewals Managers, and Account Executives in what we call a pod, a small cross-functional team that shares ownership of the customer from first sale through to renewal. You’ll own the adopt motion and share ownership of retention and growth with the colleagues around your customers. You’ll be at the forefront of Culture Amp’s work with our enterprise customers (1,000+ users), helping organisations that want to make a material impact on their culture get lasting value from Culture Amp, with a team that wins or loses together. You’ll bring a consultative, insight-led approach to a large book of enterprise customers. You’ll partner closely with People Scientists and your Account Managers and Renewals Managers to turn what a customer says they want into outcomes they can see. If you’re deeply curious, commercially confident, and energised by helping customers get real results, this role was built for you. You will Own retention and growth for a book of enterprise customers, treating GRR and NRR as yours and sharing accountability for your team’s results. Use data, health signals, and dashboards to decide where your time makes the greatest impact across a large book, and set clear, realistic expectations with customers about what they will and won’t get. Lead strategic business reviews with senior stakeholders well ahead of renewal, translating platform data into business value and a clear ROI story. Go past the stated request to the business problem underneath, and plan proactive adoption around what will actually move the needle for each customer. Spot risk early from behavioural and data signals such as a sponsor change or a usage dip, raise it openly, and lead a collaborative save plan through to resolution. Lead the conversations others avoid, from pricing and contraction risk to expansion, and bring opportunities to your Account Manager early. Build relationships across each customer beyond a single champion, and mobilise colleagues you don’t directly manage, including Account Managers, Renewals Managers, People Science, and Account Executives, to deliver customer outcomes. Build repeatable plays, use automation and AI so your approach holds up as your book grows, and share playbooks and what you learn with the wider CX team. You have 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role with accountability for retention and growth, such as customer success, account management, or renewals. Experience managing a book of enterprise customers and owning outcomes like GRR and NRR. Experience leading strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and translating product data into a story they act on. Experience partnering with Sales and Renewals teams to protect and grow revenue.

jobs.title: Senior People Science Analyst (12 month FTC)
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . We re looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team for a 12-month fixed term contract. You ll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action. GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement. As a thought leader in HR analytics, you ll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction. You ll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies. The work is technical and customer-facing. You ll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public. You ll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data. Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you ll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered. As part of this team of amazing humans, You will: Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations Design, clean, combine and explore platform and customer-supplied datasets using robust, reusable approaches that protect participant privacy Conduct rigorous statistical analyses across engagement, lifecycle, performance and team effectiveness data, generating actionable and, where appropriate, predictive insights tied to business outcomes Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while validating outputs, protecting customer data and maintaining methodological rigour Collaborate with customer-facing People Scientists on advanced HR analytics projects, applying sound judgment about methods, limitations and trade-offs Identify the themes and stories most likely to help organisations improve their culture and business outcomes, then communicate them through clear reports, presentations and internal and external thought leadership Create reusable methods, templates and assets; improve internal processes and practices; and negotiate scope, priorities and timelines to deliver high-quality work You have: An advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in organisational psychology, quantitative social science, economics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience Applied experience using quantitative research methods on people or workforce data, idea

jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . How you can help make a better world of work Culture Amp is looking for an exceptional Account Executive to join our Commercial (Mid-Market) GTM Pod. We re moving from separate Sales and CX teams into integrated pods, each bringing together AEs, Account Managers, Customer Success Managers, and Renewals Managers to collectively own the full customer journey: land, adopt, expand, and renew. As the AE in your pod, you own the land motion. You ll be at the forefront of Culture Amp s growth in the commercial segment (up to 1,000 users), hunting new logos and setting up ambitious organizations to build a better world of work for their people, with a strong foundation for your pod s AMs and CSMs to build on. You ll bring a consultative, insight-led approach to fast-moving, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You ll partner closely with SDRs and Marketing to build pipeline, and with your pod s AMs, CSMs, and Renewals Managers to set new customers up for a strong start, delivering a differentiated experience for commercial buyers and connecting their people challenges to measurable business outcomes. If you re deeply curious, commercially sharp, and energized by the challenge of winning in a competitive market, you re what we call a #peoplegeek and this role was built for you. You will Drive new logo acquisition across your commercial territory, owning the sales cycle from outbound prospecting through to close, and a clean handoff into your GTM Pod. Generate a significant portion of your own pipeline through proactive outbounding, using a combination of tools, tactics, and sales methodologies to break into target accounts. Build and manage a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce, maintaining consistent pipeline hygiene and weekly forecast updates. Run tailored product demonstrations and business case presentations for People Leaders and key stakeholders, clearly articulating Culture Amp s competitive differentiators and ROI. Build multi-threaded relationships across HR and key decision makers to drive consensus and accelerate deal velocity. Collaborate within your GTM Pod, SDRs, Marketing, Account Managers, CSMs, and Renewals Managers, to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience from first touch through to a strong start as a customer. Orchestrate pod members and broader internal partners you don t directly manage, setting new customers up for adoption and expansion from day one. Contribute to the broader Commercial team s craft, sharing learnings, participating in deal clinics, and helping raise the bar on how we sell. You have A track record of hitting targets in a quota-carrying role, whether that s as a closing AE or as a high-performing SDR ready to take the next step. Strong outbound and self-sourcing capability, with experience building pipeline from scratch rather than relying on inbound alone. jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . Join us in creating a better world of work. Culture Amp is looking for an exceptional Senior Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Customer Success team. You’ll work alongside Account Managers, Renewals Managers, and Account Executives in what we call a pod, a small cross-functional team that shares ownership of the customer from first sale through to renewal. You’ll own the adopt motion and share ownership of retention and growth with the colleagues around your customers. You’ll be at the forefront of Culture Amp’s work with our enterprise customers (1,000+ users), helping organisations that want to make a material impact on their culture get lasting value from Culture Amp, with a team that wins or loses together. You’ll bring a consultative, insight-led approach to a large book of enterprise customers. You’ll partner closely with People Scientists and your Account Managers and Renewals Managers to turn what a customer says they want into outcomes they can see. If you’re deeply curious, commercially confident, and energised by helping customers get real results, this role was built for you. You will Own retention and growth for a book of enterprise customers, treating GRR and NRR as yours and sharing accountability for your team’s results. Use data, health signals, and dashboards to decide where your time makes the greatest impact across a large book, and set clear, realistic expectations with customers about what they will and won’t get. Lead strategic business reviews with senior stakeholders well ahead of renewal, translating platform data into business value and a clear ROI story. Go past the stated request to the business problem underneath, and plan proactive adoption around what will actually move the needle for each customer. Spot risk early from behavioural and data signals such as a sponsor change or a usage dip, raise it openly, and lead a collaborative save plan through to resolution. Lead the conversations others avoid, from pricing and contraction risk to expansion, and bring opportunities to your Account Manager early. Build relationships across each customer beyond a single champion, and mobilise colleagues you don’t directly manage, including Account Managers, Renewals Managers, People Science, and Account Executives, to deliver customer outcomes. Build repeatable plays, use automation and AI so your approach holds up as your book grows, and share playbooks and what you learn with the wider CX team. You have 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role with accountability for retention and growth, such as customer success, account management, or renewals. Experience managing a book of enterprise customers and owning outcomes like GRR and NRR. Experience leading strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and translating product data into a story they act on. Experience partnering with Sales and Renewals teams to protect and grow revenue.
